# Aganim AI

> Aganim AI is a Shopify app that provides AI-powered translation, localization, and cross-border e-commerce optimization for online stores. It handles product listings, SEO metadata, pricing intelligence, marketing content generation, image refinement, and brand identity analysis across 12+ global markets.

## Core Pages

- [Home](https://aganim-ui.onrender.com/): Landing page with product overview, features, and pricing for Aganim AI
- [Features](https://aganim-ui.onrender.com/features): Detailed feature breakdown including Brand Soul, AI Rewriter, SEO optimizer, Price Scout, Marketing, Content Studio, Image Refinement, and Agentic Missions
- [Support](https://aganim-ui.onrender.com/support): Help center with feature guides, step-by-step tutorials, troubleshooting, and FAQs for Shopify merchants
- [Privacy Policy](https://aganim-ui.onrender.com/privacy-policy): Data handling practices, Shopify API scopes, GDPR compliance, and fair use policy

## About

- Type: SaaS
- Category: E-commerce, Translation, AI, Localization
- Platform: Shopify App Store
- Languages: English, Japanese (UI); 12 global markets for content generation
- Pricing: Free, Basic ($29/mo), Standard ($79/mo), Pro ($149/mo)
- Last Updated: 2026-04-13
